propositions: Three safe dependency patches (json-repair 0.63.0, genai-prices 0.1.2, botocore 1.43.69) must be landed via uv.lock update with no pyproject.toml changes, while deferring mcp 2.0 migration to epic 732b and keeping mcp pinned at 1.29.0

Targeted usage-surface unit tests (test_structured.py, test_silent_success.py, test_usage_log.py, test_usage_log_pricing_qualified_2ca9.py, test_llm_capabilities.py) and lint/typecheck gates must pass against the bumped versions
The change must be submitted through Gerrit with rebar-ticket trailer and DCO sign-off, after LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 votes
Dependabot.yml must gain an ignore rule blocking mcp semver-major updates (allowing patch/security fixes) with a header comment explaining the 732b migration deferral and removal trigger

PR #128 must receive a comment explaining the mcp rejection rationale and linking to the merged Gerrit change; epic 732b must receive a comment recording that mcp v2.0.0 is stable and v1.x is maintenance-mode only

Fallback STOP rule: if any bump fails targeted tests, drop only that package, record failure evidence in ticket comments, and land the remaining safe subset; if all fail, dependabot.yml ignore rule still lands as a standalone change
